body:
MasterLootRemind will attempt to prompt the Raid Leader to set MasterLoot on bosses if it is not already set.  

- Command-line options: `/mlr` or `/masterlootremind` 
- GUI Options available from FuBar or Minimap icon.

Options include setting the groupsize for which the addon should activate (party, raid or both)  
By default the addon prompts when group size check passes and the player or a player they are targeting targets a boss.  
Enabling the Boss Combat option will instead monitor the combatlog and prompt when a boss fight is detected.  
Enabling the Loot Reset option will try to prompt for setting Loot Method back to what it was before the addon set it to ML.
